payload.purpose_context: DocKitty claims OKF v0.2 conformance but its dates, authors and index versions differ from the spec, its page relations are not published together, and OKF readers see DocKitty bundles as unconnected pages. This mission fixes all three per ADR-0059 (#177, #176, #178).
payload.purpose_tldr: Align DocKitty metadata with OKF v0.2, publish a site-wide content graph, and export plain OKF bundles.

payload.question: Generator version string form and generated.at handling?

payload.final_answer: doc-kitty-gherkin/<version> (OKF <producer>/<version>), version from src/package.json @spec-kitty/doc-toolkit; generated.at UTC timestamp kept stable on regen unless content changes; hash moves to generated.content_hash; marker match becomes prefix match.

payload.question: How are date-only updated values read, and are they migrated?

payload.final_answer: Accepted as midnight UTC with a doc-sanity warning; docs/ and example/ migrated to T00:00:00Z.

payload.question: Email authors: migrate or map at export?

payload.final_answer: Migrate docs/ and example/ to human:<local-part>; emails accepted with a warning; export maps leftovers.
/-prefixed bundle-relative (OKF §6.1); document the reference-viewer gap and report upstream.

payload.question: Export as CLI command, build output, or both?

payload.final_answer: Both: dockitty-export-okf bin plus an always-emitted build output.
Excluded, same rule as the sitemap.
